title: Rory and the Glow-Moss Valley
verses:
The dusk settled soft over Valley of Ferns,
While Nia flew high in the velvet-blue sky.
She spotted a trail where the lantern-moss burns,
And waved to the friends who were standing nearby.

Then Rory stepped forward to lead them along,
As Ricky leaped fast through the dimming green shade.
The crickets were humming a slumberous song,
That floated across every quieted glade.

Deep down in the hollow the glowing moss shone,
Where Benny walked slow with a heavy, calm tread.
Each petal was spread on a silver-lined stone,
To light up the path to a warm mossy bed.

Now Tilly arrived at a clearing of green,
And gathered soft ferns for a pillow to share.
The peacefulest valley that ever was seen,
Was wrapped in the hush of the evening air.

Then Psittaco snuggled in Nia's warm wing,
While Ricky tucked in on a cushion of red.
The sleepy night wind began softly to sing,
As Benny laid down his big, sleepy head.

Now Rory yawned wide as he closed his bright eyes,
Surrounded by friends in the starlight so clear.
A cozy calm settled beneath the dark skies,
With dreams coming gently to everyone here.
